description: The two plots illustrate the training reward progression over steps for two different training sets — “Easy Training Set” (top) and “Hard Training Set” (bottom) — comparing two methods: “Llama-On-Policy” and “Llama-LUFFY,” each with corresponding “Easy” or “Hard” variants. Both plots share identical axes: the x-axis is labeled “Steps,” ranging from 0 to 500 with tick marks at intervals of 100, and the y-axis is labeled “Training Rewards,” ranging from 0.0 to 0.2 or slightly above, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top plot (Easy Training Set), the blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Easy”) starts near 0.0, rises steeply to about 0.2 by step 100, then plateaus with minor fluctuations around 0.25 by step 500. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Easy”) follows a similar trajectory, starting near 0.0, rising to ~0.2 by step 100, and stabilizing around 0.25–0.27 by step 500, with slightly more noise than the blue line. In the bottom plot (Hard Training Set), the blue line (“Llama-On-Policy-Hard”) begins near 0.0, rises to ~0.05 by step 50, then declines to near 0.0 by step 150 and remains flat for the rest of training. The red line (“Llama-LUFFY-Hard”) starts near 0.0, rises gradually to ~0.1 by step 150, then continues increasing with fluctuations to reach ~0.22 by step 500. Both plots include shaded regions around each line, indicating uncertainty or variance, with the red lines generally exhibiting wider shaded bands than the blue lines.
